verdict.rationale: Pendo documents its own programmatic surfaces: REST API calls for sending track events, an API endpoint to bulk-delete accounts and visitors without support, and an official MCP server exposing usage data and visitor context to AI tools. Nothing shows these cover everything the UI can do, such as guide authoring, segment management, session replay, or configuration, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: a documented API reference showing UI-to-API parity, API coverage for guides/segments/analytics configuration, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
